apps.localizedDescription:
StreamCenter is your all-in-one hub for live sports streaming.

Watch NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, soccer, MMA, boxing, and more — pulled straight from the web, with no ads interrupting the action.

• Add any sports streaming site as a custom source
• Browse live and upcoming games across every league
• Favorite your teams and leagues for instant access
• Ad-free playback powered by a built-in content blocker
• Supports m3u8 and DASH streams with native AVPlayer quality
• No account required. No subscription. Completely free.

versions.localizedDescription: Generic JSON-API discovery: any source you add is probed for common API endpoints with no site-specific code. Discovered games are parsed via a pluggable shape registry and feed a runtime sports knowledge base — canonical team names and category-to-league pairings learned from one source improve classification across all sources. ppv.to surfaces 114 games across 11 sports via API; other sites fall through to WebView scraping as before. Settings → Source Diagnostics shows raw scrape output. Apple Foundation Models (iOS 26+) with rule-based fallback. No default sources — add your own.
